# Offline skeleton fixture

This minimal fixture tests the installer; it is not a copy of the official
skeleton or evidence of Orionis runtime compatibility. It follows the inspected
`skeleton@master` contract at commit
`ea3bb1ea0384481e982225611610697b73d97401` without importing or running Orionis.

Tests copy it into disposable directories, initialize local Git repositories and
simulate uv and framework responses. Its configuration is deliberately minimal.
